sourceTitle: The Knights of England, France, and Scotland
description: "The Knights of England, France, and Scotland" by Henry William Herbert is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. The work explores the legends and tales surrounding iconic figures of chivalry from England, France, and Scotland, particularly focusing on the tumultuous events of the Norman Conquest and the subsequent rise of William the Conqueror.
